correctness.rationale: PASS: Weyl translation is unitary in the specified Gaussian Fock norm and maps span{e_0,...,e_k} to J_k(a), so the projection onto jets gives e^-lambda lambda^N/N! sum_{j=0}^k C_j(N;lambda)^2/(j! lambda^j). Charlier recurrence and d C_{j+1}/d lambda=-(j+1)C_j telescope to F prime = e^-lambda lambda^N C_k C_{k+1}/(N! k! lambda^(k+1)). For N>k the associated Laguerre C_{k+1}= (k+1)! L_{k+1}^{N-k-1} has exactly k+1 positive simple zeros, all strict local maxima; interlaced C_k zeros are minima. On lambda=N+y sqrt(N) the Charlier generating function tends to He_j(-y), giving scaled envelope H_k(y). Fixed k polynomial Poisson-tail bounds exclude escaping maximizing radii. H_k derivative is -e^-y²/2 He_k(y)He_{k+1}(y)/k!; the oscillator Sonin energy decreases between nonnegative zeros, ordering local maxima so y=0 if even k, ±smallest positive root He_{k+1} if odd k. Independent exact rational polynomial derivative checks for (N,k)=(7,2),(8,3),(11,4), plus numerical Hermite extrema k=2..8, corroborate identities but do not replace infinite proof. N<=k is not claimed for finite candidate classification.
